title.zh: 修复导师轮播布局并简化实时导师操作
title.en: Fix the tutor carousel layout and simplify live tutor controls

purpose.zh: 修复上一轮 WebKit 检出的侧边导师预览裁切与控件重叠，同时让手机上的实时导师入口更直接。
purpose.en: Resolve side-preview clipping and control overlap found by the prior WebKit run, while making live tutor controls more direct on phones.

zh: 导师照片保持完整比例；两侧预览在自身边界内裁切、加深遮罩，停用通话中切换。
照片下方按聊天、开始／结束、音色图标排列；音色只列出与导师形象相符的声音，通话中禁用。
文字导师首次介绍不自动朗读，移除顶部停止朗读按钮；说明与文字练习设置移到实时导师面板之后。
en: Keep the selected portrait uncropped while side previews crop within their own bounds, use stronger shading, and lock during calls.
Place chat, Start/End, and an icon-only voice selector below the portrait; offer only voices matching the portrait and disable changes during calls.
Do not auto-read the initial text introduction, remove the upper Stop voice button, and move detailed guidance and text settings below the live tutor panel.

zh: 旗舰版一对一导师页面、实时语音偏好 API、WebKit 发布验证；不改订阅或付款。
en: Max one-to-one tutor, live-voice preference API, and WebKit release validation; no subscription or payment change.

zh: 服务端与界面共同校验导师形象和音色；旧会话的不匹配音色在读取和连接时采用相符默认值，数据库结构不变。
保留全部 310 组 WebKit 页面、语言及视口测量；独立访问控制改为最多四路并行，并在同一发布中复用已编译的测量程序。
en: Validate portrait and voice together in client and server; normalize legacy mismatched choices when reading or connecting, without a schema change.
Keep all 310 WebKit route-language-viewport measurements; run independent access controls in bounded groups of four and reuse the compiled measurement harness within the release.

zh: 站点策略门禁、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全套测试、构建与中英文 WebKit 响应式检查。
发布后实测宽屏轮播、手机控制排列、音色筛选，核对精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Site policy gates, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, build, and Chinese/English responsive WebKit checks.
After deployment, inspect the wide carousel, phone control order, filtered voice selector, and exact Project release record.

zh: 不提交付款；自动化不录制或保存真实学员音频。
en: No payment is submitted; automated checks do not record or store real learner audio.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 现有导师照片、GPT-Live 音色和十三种界面语言。
en: Reuse SmartLingo's existing tutor portraits, GPT-Live voices, and thirteen interface locales.

rollback.zh: 部署上一稳定提交；数据库结构无变更。
rollback.en: Deploy the previous stable commit; no database schema change is involved.
